channel.description: A 23-chapter handbook for Claude Code — permissions, context, skills, hooks, MCP and agents, worked out end to end for engineers who have to ship with it.

item.title: Permission Modes
item.author: abhaypratap3537@gmail.com (Abhay)
item.description: The six permission modes, what each one auto-approves, the auto-mode classifier's default block and allow lists, the thresholds at which it stops trusting itself, and the protected and critical paths no mode will auto-approve.
